label: VERIFIED
extraction: LLM Hosting Comparison: Ollama vs vLLM vs LM Studio vs LocalAI vs Jan. For production agent systems requiring robust tool calling, containerize vLLM or LocalAI directly rather than using Model Runner. 2025 advances: API standardization (OpenAI compatibility across all major tools). Start with LM Studio for UI/ease, or Jan for privacy-first simplicity. Developers: Ollama for API integration/flexibility. API Maturity: Beta stage with OpenAI-compatible API. Sanctum AI emphasizes privacy with offline-first mobile/desktop. Lemonade: new approach optimized for AMD hardware with NPU. All tools run LLMs locally without cloud APIs.
